votes.motion: Commissioner Tonks motioned to approve the Planning Commission Meeting Minutes for August 26, 2021
Commissioner Nixon motioned to approve the Planning Commission Meeting Minutes for September 9, 2021, with changes discussed in the meeting

Commissioner Fowler motioned to forward a positive recommendation to City Council for the Crosspoint CSD Zoning Text Amendment request, as requested by Ralph Johnson of Utah Capital LLC, Application TA-051-2018, as modified by the following: • Remove the high efficiency glass language • Noting that setbacks shall be 20 feet from all streets • Length of parking spaces shall be 18 feet 8 • Lighting shall meet DCMC • One monument sign will be allowed per office building • Phrasing for way finding signs will be for informational signs • The retaining shall meet DCMC

Commissioner Nixon motioned to forward a positive recommendation to City Council for the Crosspoint CSD Zoning Map Amendment request, as requested by Ralph Johnson of Utah Capital LLC, Application GPM-002-2018, based on the findings listed in the staff report, dated September 26, 2021
Commissioner Tonks motioned to move item six of the agenda to the next item in the agenda

Commissioner Tonks motioned to send a positive recommendation to City Council for the 7th East Office Building Zoning Map Amendment request, as requested by Ben Clifford representing Phillip Matthews and the Maydea Fitzgerald Trust, application TEXTMAP-0139-2021, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report, dated September 29, 2021

Commissioner Fowler motioned to send a positive recommendation to City Council for the Rockwell Station Zoning Map Amendment, as request by Adam Watts representing Brad Stevens, Lisa Stevens and Gary Sturdevant for application TEXTMAP-0141-2021, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report, dated September 30, 2021

Commissioner Fowler motioned to send a positive recommendation to City Council, requested by Nathan Abbot, representing Galloway & Company for application TEXTMAP-080-2021, based on the findings listed in the staff report, dated September 29, 2021

Commissioner Fowler motioned to conditionally approve the site plan amendment based on the findings and subject to the specific and general conditions listed within the staff report, dated September 30, 2021, as requested by Mark McKee representing Arco Design/Build and Exeter Draper Land LLC, for the Summit Commerce Center Site Plan Amendment, Application SPR-0128-2021. The site plan approval shall become effective upon written notice from the zoning administrator that the specific conditions of approval have been met.
